headline: Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf Churn as Flanking Fronts Subside
war_summary: Over the past three hours, tactical line changes have narrowed sharply along the northern perimeter, turning Stlican Shelf and the Weathered Expanse into the twin crucibles of active maneuver while neighboring sectors subside. Both regions recorded vigorous swings right up to the latest telegraphic wire, each registering between nine and eleven base transitions over the past two hours amid relentless exchanges across positions like Shattered Advance, Wightwalk, Breaker Town, and Fort Hoarfrost. In sharp contrast, the frantic fighting earlier observed in Viper Pit and Marban Hollow has collapsed into relative stillness, with base contestations halting completely after daybreak. At Callahan's Passage, direct territorial turnover at The Latch has similarly ceased since dawn, yet the hex remains an attritional furnace, absorbing nearly fourteen hundred combined casualties in two hours as both armies maintain dense battle lines. Meanwhile, Linn of Mercy's frontline movements have quieted despite ongoing troop arrivals, even as casualty rates begin to accelerate in Stonecradle and Farranac Coast, hinting at emerging pressure along the western approaches.
